event_chain.summary: Misconfiguration: redaction failure after software update exposed redacted data in disclosure packages

summary: A technical issue with New Zealand Police's Investigation Management Tool (IMT), linked to a software update, caused redactions in disclosure packages produced from 4 December 2025 not to be applied correctly. Police found 1,527 disclosure packages from 1,037 cases were affected and identified 46 occasions where private information was shared unintentionally.
